fit: Parkinson medication crossover and composite motor outcomes without fresh sage
assessment: The matched parent DIVE-I trial measured dyskinesia and bradykinesia combined. Secondary measures combine dystonia with dyskinesia or other motor indicators. No separate dystonia effect or fresh sage. Overlap with the later case remains unverified.

fit: assigned whole dried-date comparator without Parkinson pain severity outcome
assessment: A twelve-week randomized older-adult trial assigned dried dates against frozen blueberries. No standalone pain endpoint is registered and no group outcomes are posted.

fit: assigned dried dates compared with frozen blueberries and planned cognition outcomes
assessment: The date intervention is stated only in the protocol and allocation. Older adults are not a specified Parkinson cohort, cognition is not apathy, and no group results are posted.

fit: whole date plan with food-specific reward and appetite hormones
assessment: The registration tests added dates in type 2 diabetes. The Power of Food Scale concerns hedonic hunger. Date maturity and drying are unstated, a narrative fragment refers to persimmon, and no clinical outcomes are posted.

fit: fresh-sage extract and composite menopausal symptom outcome
assessment: The terminated placebo comparison planned sweating, menopause and cognition endpoints. It has no posted outcomes or dedicated Parkinson apathy result.

fit: controlled dried common-sage leaf and condition-specific acute alertness
assessment: Table 1 and Figure 3 show the higher dose increased alertness before the stress task but reduced the one-hour during-task change relative to placebo. The healthy adult crossover measures no clinical apathy.

fit: common-sage extract with Spanish-sage oil and mood scales
assessment: The 94-person healthy-adult trial found no clear Bond-Lader or anxiety effect. NCT03695003 is a probable registry link, without an explicit identifier cross-link. Count one family and keep it distinct from culinary dried common sage.
